title: Stephen F. Austin and Sam Houston to meet in Battle of the Piney Woods tennis match
text:
Stephen F. Austin and Sam Houston will compete in the 23rd Battle of the Piney Woods tennis match on March 19 at 1:00 p.m.
The annual matchup is significant for both programs, with Stephen F. Austin currently trailing in the series, 10-12. The teams last met in 2023, when Sam Houston won 6-1. Stephen F. Austin’s most recent victory over Sam Houston came in a close 4-3 contest during the 2022 season.
Sam Houston enters the match with a four-game winning streak but holds a season record of 7-9. In Conference USA play, they are undefeated at 2-0 and rank third in their conference standings. The Bearkats recently secured a win against Middle Tennessee and have an even singles record this year, led by Nayuma Subba with a 10-4 mark and Ana Kurtsikashvili at 9-3. In doubles, Christine Jevicky and Subba lead with four wins as a pair, while other combinations are also on winning streaks.
Stephen F. Austin has a season record of 3-6 but is coming off three consecutive victories, including its first sweep of the year against New Orleans with a score of 7-0. Ksenia Mamontova was named Southland Conference Player of the Week for her recent performances, while Sonja Rooth has extended her singles record to 7-1 after two more wins over the weekend.
In doubles play, Mamontova and Alkmini Giannakogiorgou remain undefeated as partners at 2-0. A sweep against Sam Houston would bring Stephen F. Austin’s doubles record to .500 for the season.
Fans can follow updates about Stephen F. Austin Tennis through SFAjacks.com or via social media platforms X, Instagram, and Facebook.
